name: ez barbell preacher curl
description: Curling an EZ bar over a preacher pad, which keeps your upper arms still so your biceps do the work.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.
